title: Phrases
subtitle: A2 · Unit 10: Food, shopping and quantities

steps.title: Phrases
steps.body: Say the full phrase, then shorten it with en. Write one personal shopping example in your notes and change only the amount; the listener should still understand what you mean.

steps.title: Say the whole block
steps.body: Learn these as blocks, exactly as you hear them. Say each one out loud. Tap the speaker to hear it.

steps.fr: Des fraises ? J'en prends une barquette.
steps.en: Strawberries? I am taking a punnet.
steps.tip: Say it: day frehz; zhah(n) prahn ün bah-REHT

steps.fr: Du lait végétal ? J'en prends un litre.
steps.en: Plant-based milk? I am taking a litre of it.
steps.tip: Say it: dü leh vay-zhay-TAHL; zhah(n) prahn uh(n) leetr

steps.fr: Tu veux des lentilles ? Oui, j'en veux.
steps.en: Do you want lentils? Yes, I want some.
steps.tip: Say it: tü vuh day lah(n)-TEE-yuh; wee, zhah(n) vuh

steps.fr: Combien de yaourts ? J'en prends quatre.
steps.en: How many yogurts? I am taking four.
steps.tip: Say it: koh(n)-BYAH(N) duh yah-OOR; zhah(n) prahn kahtr

steps.fr: Il reste du pain ? Oui, il en reste la moitié.
steps.en: Is there bread left? Yes, half of it is left.
steps.tip: Say it: eel rehst dü pa(n); wee, eel ah(n) rehst ün mwah-TYAY

steps.fr: Je vais acheter des tomates; je vais en prendre six.
steps.en: I am going to buy tomatoes; I will take six.
steps.tip: Say it: zhuh veh ahsh-TAY day toh-MAHT; zhuh veh ah(n) prahn-druh sees

steps.fr: Tu prends du fromage ? J'en prends un morceau.
steps.en: Are you taking cheese? I am taking a piece.
steps.tip: Say it: tü prahn dü froh-MAHZH; zhah(n) prahn uh(n) mohr-SOH

steps.fr: Ce produit est trop cher. Je n'en prends pas.
steps.en: This product is too expensive. I am not taking any.
steps.tip: Say it: suh proh-DÜEE eh troh shehr; zhuh nah(n) prahn pah
